orb.error: Sorry, something went wrong. Try again.
orb.no_route: No active trip. Create a plan first.
orb.identify_failed: We could not recognise the place.
orb.prompt_landmarks: Show me 3 of the most interesting landmarks
orb.add_failed: We could not add the place.

maintenance.desc: We are building something good. Check back soon.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.desc: The app hit an error. Try going back to the home screen.

body.offline: Your phone has no signal or Wi-Fi. Your data is safe and will be back once you reconnect.
body.server: Your internet works, but our server is not responding. This usually passes in a moment.
body.update: A new version shipped and this screen is from the old one. A refresh is all it takes.
body.technical: This is a bug in the app, not something you did. Nothing is lost - everything you saved is still there.

cookies.intro: We use cookies for analytics and personalisation.

moderation.rejected: That photo did not pass moderation and was not added

heic.failed: We could not process that HEIC photo. Try a JPG or PNG.

update.title: Update the app
update.body: This version of spontaway is out of date. Update the app so everything works as it should.

list_created.title: Collection ready
list_created.desc: Want to know when someone likes or saves your collection? Turn on notifications - we only send the ones about reactions to your content and invites from friends.

trip_created.title: Trip ready
trip_created.desc: We'll let you know when friends answer your invite and, once you publish, when someone likes or saves your trip. No spam, just reactions to your content.

trip_published.title: Trip published
trip_published.desc: Want to know when someone likes or saves your trip? Turn on notifications - no spam, just reactions to your content.

invite_sent.title: Invites sent
invite_sent.desc: Turn on notifications to know when your friends answer and write in the trip chat.

bell.title: Turn on notifications
bell.desc: Know right away when someone likes or saves your trip or collection, invites you to a trip or writes in the chat.
bell.short: Reactions to your trips and collections, invites, trip chat.

settings.title: Turn on notifications
settings.desc: Know right away when someone likes or saves your trip or collection, invites you to a trip or writes in the chat.

denied.title: Notifications are off
denied.desc: Turn them on in your phone settings: Settings → Spontaway → Notifications.
denied.short: Turned off in phone settings. Tap to turn them on.

browse.title: Are you in the city?
browse.desc: Turn on location and you'll see how far each place is, sorted from the nearest. Your position stays on your phone - we never store it.

denied.title: Location is off
denied.desc: Turn it on in your phone settings: Settings → Spontaway → Location.
